en.name: Whole fish, frozen raw
en.summary: Raw headed-and-gutted fish keeps 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep it frozen and cook it as directed. Once cooked, it keeps 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage, and no counter thawing. Raw fish is among the fastest-spoiling foods there is: it carries cold-adapted bacteria that keep working at temperatures where meat bacteria slow down, and its own enzymes soften the flesh from the inside. Once out of the freezer it is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) within the hour, and the two-hour rule applies — one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once it has been cooked, covered, and that is what the figure describes — storage after cooking, not a licence to keep thawed raw fish for days. Thawed raw fish should be cooked the day it thaws, or the day after at the outside. Keep it on the bottom shelf in a dish so nothing drips onto other food, and pour off any liquid that collects.
en.freezer: 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — shorter than most frozen foods, because the oils in fish continue to oxidise slowly even at freezer temperature, and that is what produces the rancid, painty taste of an over-kept fish. Kept continuously at −18 °C it stays safe indefinitely; safety is not what runs out. Wrap it tightly, or glaze it by dipping it in cold water and refreezing to build an ice layer, which is what protects oily fish best. Oily fish such as mackerel or salmon use up their window faster than lean white fish.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge overnight on a dish, or in a sealed bag under cold running water for quicker results. Never on the counter and never in warm water. Fish thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; fish thawed any other way must not be refrozen.
spoilage: A sharp ammonia or sour smell, which is decisive — throw it out.
Dry, white, frost-burned patches and a papery surface.
Flesh that has gone yellow or brown at the edges, a sign the oils have oxidised.
Mushy flesh that will not hold together, or a print that stays when you press it.
tips: Glaze fish in ice before long freezing; it protects the oils better than film alone.
Freeze it flat and label it with the date and the species.
Cook oily fish earlier in its window than lean white fish.
Thaw in the fridge on a plate, never on the counter.

faq.q: How long can you keep raw fish frozen?
faq.a: 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. It stays safe longer if it never thaws, but the oils oxidise and it tastes rancid.

faq.q: How do you thaw frozen fish safely?
faq.a: Overnight in the fridge on a dish, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter or in warm water.

faq.q: Can you refreeze fish that has thawed?
faq.a: Only if it thawed in the fridge and is still at or below 4 °C (40 °F), and expect some quality loss. Fish thawed any other way should be cooked at once or discarded.

zh.name: 冷凍生鮮全魚
zh.summary: 去頭去內臟的生鮮魚在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 6 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示煮熟。煮熟之後，蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存，也不能在檯面上退冰。生魚是所有食物裡壞得最快的一類：牠身上帶的是耐低溫的細菌，在肉類細菌已經慢下來的溫度還在工作，而魚自身的酵素又會從內部把肉質軟化。離開冷凍不到一小時，它就落進 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶，適用兩小時原則——廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，而這正是那個數字描述的狀態——「煮熟之後」，不是說解凍的生魚可以在冷藏擺好幾天。解凍的生魚應該當天煮掉，最多不要超過隔天。請放在冰箱最下層、墊一個盤子，避免血水滴到別的食物上，並隨時把積出來的水倒掉。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 6 個月品質最好——比多數冷凍食品短，因為魚油即使在冷凍溫度下仍會緩慢氧化，而那正是放過頭的魚會有那種油耗、像油漆味的原因。只要全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的；先用完的不是安全。請包緊，或用「冰衣」的做法：浸一下冷水再放回冷凍，結出一層冰殼，那對多脂魚的保護最好。鯖魚、鮭魚這類多脂魚用掉期限的速度，比白肉瘦魚快。
zh.thawing: 放盤子裡冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋泡在流動冷水下快速解凍。絕對不要放檯面，也絕對不要泡溫水。在冷藏解凍、且始終維持在 4 °C 以下的魚可以再冷凍，只是品質會打折；用其他方式解凍的絕對不能再冷凍。
spoilage: 刺鼻的氨味或酸味——這是決定性的，直接丟掉。
表面出現乾白的凍燒斑塊，摸起來像紙。
魚肉邊緣轉黃或轉褐，表示油脂已經氧化。
肉質糊爛不成形，或壓下去的凹痕彈不回來。
tips: 長期冷凍前先做冰衣；它對油脂的保護比單靠保鮮膜好。
平放冷凍，並在袋上寫下日期和魚種。
多脂魚要比白肉瘦魚更早吃掉。
放盤子裡冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面。

faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 6 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但油脂會氧化、吃起來有油耗味。

faq.q: 冷凍魚要怎麼安全解凍？
faq.a: 放盤子裡冷藏隔夜，或密封裝袋泡流動冷水。絕對不要放檯面或泡溫水。

faq.q: 解凍過的魚可以再冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 只有在冷藏解凍、而且還維持在 4 °C 以下的才可以，而且品質會打折。用其他方式解凍的請馬上煮掉或丟掉。
